parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use correct product or quotient rule. [M1]
Obtain correct derivative in any form. [A1] Guidance: e.g. $dy/dx=(\cos^2x+2x\sin x\cos x)/\cos^4x$, or $\sec^2x+2x\sec^2x\tan x$.
Equate derivative at $x=a$ to 12 and obtain $a=\cos^{-1}(((\cos a+2a\sin a)/12)^{1/3})$. [A1 AG] Total: 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Evaluate a relevant expression or pair of expressions at $a=0.9$ and $a=1$. [M1] Guidance: must be calculated in radians.
Complete the argument correctly with correct values. [A1] Printed examples: $\cos0.9=0.622>0.553$ and $\cos1=0.540<0.570$; or $0.9<0.985$ and $1>0.964$; or residuals $0.0846>0$ and $-0.0358<0$; or gradient values $8.46$ and $14.1$. Total: 2.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use $a_{n+1}=\cos^{-1}(((\cos a_n+2a_n\sin a_n)/12)^{1/3})$ correctly at least once. [M1] Guidance: must be working in radians.
Obtain $0.97$. [A1]
Show sufficient iterations to 4 decimal places to justify 0.97, or a sign change on $(0.965,0.975)$. [A1] Guidance: e.g. $0.9500,0.9743,0.9694,0.9704$. Total: 3.
